module_summary: 1G Ethernet MAC top that wires an AXI-Stream-to-GMII transmitter and a GMII-to-AXI-Stream receiver in separate clock domains; MAC control/pause logic is parameter-disabled, so AXIS ports pass straight through.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Transmit AXI-Stream payload byte forwarded to the GMII transmitter.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Transmit AXI-Stream valid feeding the transmitter input handshake.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tready
anchors.why: Transmit AXI-Stream ready, copied from the GMII transmitter's s_axis_tready.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker of the transmit stream.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received AXI-Stream payload byte from the GMII receiver.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Received stream valid; no ready, receiver pushes data each cycle.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Receive sideband user bits (bad-frame flag, optional timestamp).

anchors.name: gmii_rxd
anchors.why: GMII receive data byte entering the receiver instance.

anchors.name: gmii_rx_dv
anchors.why: GMII receive data valid framing incoming bytes.

anchors.name: gmii_txd
anchors.why: GMII transmit data byte produced by the transmitter instance.

anchors.name: gmii_tx_en
anchors.why: GMII transmit enable marking valid transmitted bytes.

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Configured inter-frame gap length used by the transmitter.

anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
anchors.why: Enables the transmit path in the GMII transmitter.

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Enables the receive path in the GMII receiver.

anchors.name: tx_mii_select
anchors.why: Selects MII nibble mode versus GMII byte mode for transmit.

anchors.name: rx_mii_select
anchors.why: Selects MII nibble mode versus GMII byte mode for receive.

anchors.name: tx_clk_enable
anchors.why: Clock enable qualifying transmitter cycles (for MII/lower rates).

anchors.name: rx_clk_enable
anchors.why: Clock enable qualifying receiver cycles.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Receiver reports frame with failing CRC32 FCS.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Receiver reports malformed or errored frame.

anchors.name: tx_error_underflow
anchors.why: Transmitter reports AXIS underflow during a frame.

anchors.name: tx_start_packet
anchors.why: Pulse indicating transmitter started a new packet.

anchors.name: rx_start_packet
anchors.why: Pulse indicating receiver started a new packet.

groups.name: Transmit path
groups.description: axis_gmii_tx converts transmit AXI-Stream into GMII bytes with preamble, FCS and IFG.

groups.name: Receive path
groups.description: axis_gmii_rx strips preamble, checks FCS and emits receive AXI-Stream.

groups.name: Disabled MAC control
groups.description: LFC/PFC pause logic disabled by MAC_CTRL_ENABLE=0; outputs tied to zero.
